## Professional Summary

Backend Engineer specializing in REST API design, authentication systems (JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC), payment integrations (Stripe, Apple App Store, Google Play), and PostgreSQL database architecture. Currently at The Bubble Hub, leading backend development across two mobile products serving thousands of monthly active users.
